'''Cheese''' is a food and base [[ingredient]] made from [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]]s. It heals {{Value|Cheese|heals}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/cheese.json}}</ref> It replaces {{MCW|Cookie|cookies}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A milk bottle, sugar and a brown mushroom make 4 cheese. Obtaining a milk bucket or a milk bottle unlocks the recipe. The milk bottle's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up ([[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating cheese heals {{Value|Cheese|heals}}.

Obtaining cheese unlocks the three [[Pizza|pizzas]]. Cheese is also used in [[bruschetta]], [[gnocchi]], [[pupusa]]s, the [[Sweet Berry Danish|sweet berry Danish]] and [[Paneer Curry Stock|paneer curry stock]].
